t: Time 6491X green/yellow conduit cable provides premium-grade earthing and bonding for light fittings, appliances, switchgear and control gear. This 10m coil features a substantial single-core 10mm² stripped bare copper wire rated 450/750V. Engineered for semi-flush, exposed and embedded conduit installations, the PVC sheath maintains performance between -15°C and 70°C. The substantial 5.9mm external diameter with seven strands per core delivers exceptional current capacity and longevity for high-demand industrial, commercial and infrastructure electrical networks.
